decisions.reason: Because this condenser survived while similar adjacent launches were pruned, management would infer that its results are at least near aspiration levels and, in a growing firm with some slack, keep it while continuing to monitor performance.

The tube-liner offering strengthens the firm's repair and lifecycle-service business, likely compares favorably with internal aspirations after one year on the market, and requires little strategic stretch, so withdrawal is unlikely.

This customized air-cooler line fits the firm's engineering-led solution model and broad customer base, and absent clear evidence of a shortfall below aspiration levels management would keep it and use slack to support further learning.
